tips:
## Encyclopedic Prose Style and Academic Reading

### Encyclopedic Writing Style

Hebrew encyclopedia articles use a formal, factual style. Key features:

1. **Third person** — describes topics objectively
2. **Passive voice** — עודכן (was updated), פורסם (was published), נלקח (was taken)
3. **Construct chains** — אוכלוסיית ישראל (the population of Israel), שטח המדינה (the area of the state)

### Article Structure

| Hebrew | English | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| הגדרה | Definition | Opening explanation |
| סעיף | Section | Content division |
| מקור | Source | Where info comes from |
| הפנייה | Reference | Link to related article |
| עובדה | Fact | Verified information |

### Useful Reading Vocabulary

- **ערך** has two meanings:
  1. Article/entry (in an encyclopedia)
  2. Value/worth

- **בערך** means "approximately" — a different use of the same word!
  - הערך הזה חשוב (This article is important)
  - בערך מאה אנשים (approximately a hundred people)

### Construct State with אוכלוסייה

Note the construct form: **אוכלוסיית** (population of)
- אוכלוסיי**ת** ישראל — the population of Israel
- אוכלוסיי**ת** העיר — the population of the city

The ה ending changes to ת in the construct form, following the standard feminine pattern.
